name: Swipehouse
all_locations: Boston, MA, USA; Cambridge, MA, USA
long_description:
The biggest social network in the world for TikTok celebs. One of the first 5 companies in the US to get the TikTok API. Launched over 400 companies on TikTok in under a year.

Work with Ridge, Hopper, and more. Acquired in 2021.
one_liner: Meet other creators. Get daily matches. Find brand deals.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Building in healthcare + AI. Previously: founding team of M365 Copilot (0→100M MAU), shipped DALL-E into Microsoft Designer (two Super Bowl ads). SwipeHouse (YC W18, exited 2021). Forbes 30u30, Harvard CS. LP at Pioneer Fund. Co-founded Fair Opportunity Project ($5M+ in scholarships, 2024). lukeheine.com

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
👋😇

Open to consulting/contracting opportunities in engineering/product/design. 
- I have a lot of experience across the board and make lots of 0-1 products. 
- I love building snappy interfaces (eg http://coursegrep.com). 
- Great with fullstack typescript, with tools like bun, expo, nextjs, and wxt. 
- Great with AI, e.g. LLM APIs, embeddings / semantic search, training/inference on lambdalabs/modal/beam/replicate/mac
- I love programming. I experiment a lot and browse github very regularly.
